postconditions: A new reservation is created atomically only when capacity is available.
A successful repeated request returns its original reservation in its current state and creates no additional reservation.

action.reserve.behavior:
Validate identity and input before lookup or mutation.
The request key is scoped to principal_id and action.reserve.
Bind a successful key to concert_id and reservation ID; reusing the key with another concert_id yields IdempotencyConflict.
An identical retry returns the same reservation ID and CURRENT state, including after cancellation, without new side effects.
Look up an earlier success BEFORE checking new capacity; a full venue must not turn a successful retry into SoldOut.
Only a new key attempts to create a new reservation.
Reject a new reservation with SoldOut when the number of reservations in reserved equals capacity.
Key uniqueness, capacity protection, creation and key binding must be part of the same atomic database operation or transaction.
Concurrent transactions must produce a result equivalent to a valid sequential order under these rules; an unprotected check-then-insert is insufficient.
A failed creation does not bind the request key and leaves no reservation.

gdd.notes: absent is a modeling marker for a reservation that does not yet exist; it is never stored.
The state machine describes mutations. Validation, errors and idempotent return paths are defined in the action contracts.
cancelled is terminal for mutations but may still be read and returned during an authorized retry.

scenario.cancel.description: Same ID in cancelled; zero active reservations; available seats never exceed capacity.

scenario.given: A owns a reserved reservation for a concert with capacity=1.
scenario.when: A cancels twice, including concurrent requests.
scenario.then: Same ID in cancelled; zero active reservations; available seats never exceed capacity.

scenario.cancel_concurrent.description: Both return the same cancelled ID; the seat is released only once.

scenario.given: A owns one reserved reservation.
scenario.then: Both return the same cancelled ID; the seat is released only once.

scenario.given: Authenticated user; empty reservation_id.
scenario.then: InvalidInput; no mutation.

scenario.cancel_once.description: The same ID is returned as cancelled; one seat is released.

scenario.given: A owns a reserved reservation.
scenario.then: The same ID is returned as cancelled; one seat is released.

scenario.given: No server-authenticated principal.
scenario.then: Unauthenticated; no lookup or mutation.

scenario.concert_missing.description: ConcertNotFound; the key is not bound.

scenario.given: Authenticated user; new key; concert does not exist.
scenario.then: ConcertNotFound; the key is not bound.

scenario.concurrent_same_key.description: Both return the same reservation ID; exactly one reservation is created.

scenario.given: C has capacity=2; A has not yet used K1.
scenario.when: A sends two identical reserve requests with K1 concurrently.
scenario.then: Both return the same reservation ID; exactly one reservation is created.

scenario.foreign_cancel.description: ReservationNotFound; no change and no reservation data returned.

scenario.given: A owns reservation R; B is authenticated as B.
scenario.when: B attempts to cancel R, including a forged owner_id in the request body. Repeat for both reserved and cancelled states.
scenario.then: ReservationNotFound; no change and no reservation data returned.

scenario.key_conflict.description: IdempotencyConflict; no new reservation or capacity change in any concert.

scenario.given: A has reserved concert C1 using K1.
scenario.when: A uses K1 for concert C2.
scenario.then: IdempotencyConflict; no new reservation or capacity change in any concert.

scenario.last_seat.description: Exactly one reservation succeeds; the other yields SoldOut; at most one seat is occupied. Run against the selected database's actual transaction behavior.

scenario.given: Concert C has one available seat; A and B each have a new request key.
scenario.when: Two separate database connections attempt concurrent reservations with controlled overlap.
scenario.then: Exactly one reservation succeeds; the other yields SoldOut; at most one seat is occupied. Run against the selected database's actual transaction behavior.

scenario.replay.description: The same reservation ID is returned every time; no extra seat is occupied; no SoldOut on a retry.

scenario.given: C has capacity=1; A's reserve request with K1 succeeded and took the last seat.
scenario.when: A repeats the same request several times, including concurrently.
scenario.then: The same reservation ID is returned every time; no extra seat is occupied; no SoldOut on a retry.

scenario.replay_after_cancel.description: K1 returns R in cancelled without mutation. K2 may create a new ID if capacity is available; R remains cancelled.

scenario.given: A reserved using K1 and then cancelled reservation R.
scenario.when: A repeats the original reserve request with K1 and then creates a new one with K2.
scenario.then: K1 returns R in cancelled without mutation. K2 may create a new ID if capacity is available; R remains cancelled.

scenario.given: Authenticated user; reservation does not exist.
scenario.then: ReservationNotFound without reservation data.

scenario.reserve.description: One reservation ID in reserved for A, and exactly one seat occupied.

scenario.given: Concert C has capacity=1 and no reservations; user A is authenticated.
scenario.when: A reserves C using key K1.
scenario.then: One reservation ID in reserved for A, and exactly one seat occupied.

scenario.given: Authenticated user; empty concert_id or request_key.
scenario.then: InvalidInput; no mutation.

scenario.given: No server-authenticated principal.
scenario.when: Reserve is called with otherwise valid input.
scenario.then: Unauthenticated; no lookup or mutation.

scenario.sold_out.description: SoldOut; no mutation or key binding.

scenario.given: The concert is full; the user has a new key.
scenario.then: SoldOut; no mutation or key binding.

scenario.given: The concert has capacity=0.
scenario.when: A valid new reservation is attempted.
scenario.then: SoldOut; zero active reservations.
